description: Assigns a Service Account to a Project with specified roles in MongoDB Atlas.. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/tree/master/cfn-resources/service-account-project-assignment

OrgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization. Required for List operation.

ClientId.description: The Client ID of the Service Account.

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

Roles.description: The Project permissions for the Service Account in the specified Project.

Profile.description: Profile used to provide credentials information, (a secret with the cfn/atlas/profile/{Profile}, is required), if not provided default is used

title: MongoDBAtlasServiceAccountProjectAssignmentProperties
